WTA Mérida 

Camila Osorio vs Janice Tjen

🧠 Form & Context

🇨🇴 Camila Osorio (#61, RH; 162 cm)

📈 2026: 9–4 on hard (strong start to the year on this surface)

✅ Big week in Manila highlighted by a three-set final win over Donna Vekic

🔁 Hard-court profile is still a grind: lower hold rate and a shakier second serve can invite long, tense games

⚠️ Tight-match trend: recent hard losses often come down to a few clutch points (tiebreak record has been a problem)

🇮🇩 Janice Tjen (#36, RH)

📉 2026: 5–6 on hard (results uneven, but many matches vs elite level opponents)

✅ Statement wins early this year (including a dominant win over Haddad Maia)

💥 Hard 52 numbers look “Top-30-ish”: strong hold rate, strong second-serve stability, and elite tiebreak performance

🧊 Clutch edge: if sets reach 5–5 / 6–6, she’s been the more reliable closer

🔍 Match Breakdown is for Patreon Elites.
